styleGuide.title: Style guide

howTo.title: Colors are changed in a single place
howTo.description: ClockMetrics uses the same colors as InvenTrack, in light and dark mode. They are all in the file below: change a value there and the whole app updates.

styleGuide.semanticHint: Components only use these names, never a fixed color.
styleGuide.statusHint: For difference statuses and errors. They stay the same with any brand color.
styleGuide.hintBody: It is the local fund balance at month close, as shown in ACMS.

login.title: Sign in
login.welcomeDescription: Track attendance and hours worked from one place, simply and securely.

placeholder.description: This screen is still under construction.

users.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? If they already recorded data it cannot be deleted: deactivate them instead.
users.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own user.
users.search: Search by name, username or ID
users.newPasswordHint: Leave it empty to keep it. If filled, the account is also unlocked.
users.usernameHint: Used to sign in. It is built from the name; you can edit it.
users.usernameInvalid: It must be name.surname: lowercase letters without accents, one dot and, if needed, a number at the end.

roles.subtitle: What each role can do is fixed in the system. Here you choose which menus it sees.
roles.deleteWithUsers: "{{name}}" has {{count}} user(s): they lose this role if it is deleted. Continue?
roles.protected: The M-BOS role cannot be renamed, deactivated or deleted.
roles.newRoleHint: A new role can only view: recording data is limited to M-BOS and Analista.
roles.protectedMenus: The M-BOS role always sees every menu.
roles.deleteMessage: Delete the role "{{name}}"? Users who have it will lose it. This cannot be undone.

audit.subtitle: Who created, edited or deleted each record, the day and the time. Kept for 3 years.
audit.maskedHint: Passwords and tokens are stored hidden (***).

400.title: Invalid request
400.description: The request could not be processed. Check the data and try again.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: You need to sign in to access this content.

403.title: Access denied
403.description: You don't have permission to view this section.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The content you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.

500.title: Server error
500.description: Something unexpected happened. Please try again later.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.description: The service isn't available right now. Please try again later.

default.title: An error occurred
default.description: Something went wrong. Please try again.

charts.reportError: The chart report could not be generated.

shortcuts.dateOpen: Date: open the calendar (move with arrows)
shortcuts.dateMonth: Open calendar: previous or next month
shortcuts.dateDay: Date: one day more or less
shortcuts.selectPick: Open list: choose (Tab also moves to the next field)
shortcuts.selectType: Option list: type the first letters to choose
shortcuts.prevField: Go back to the previous field
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.footer: Letter shortcuts do not work while typing in a field; Save, Esc and Ctrl/⌘ shortcuts do.
shortcuts.palette: Search a screen and go to it
shortcuts.sidebar: Show or hide the side menu
shortcuts.search: Go to the list search box
shortcuts.paletteSearch: Type the name of a screen...
shortcuts.paletteHint: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to open, Esc to close

attendance.pickEmployeeHint: Choose the period and the employee to see their record.
attendance.reportError: The report could not be generated.
attendance.periodClosedHint: This period is closed: no adjustments can be made. Reopen it in Catalogs › Periods.
attendance.noPeriods: There are no periods yet: import the time clock file.

adjust.title: Adjust day · {{name}}
adjust.overrideHint: These times replace the time clock ones for the calculation only; the originals are kept.
adjust.excuseLateAm: Do not count the morning late arrival
adjust.excuseLatePm: Do not count the afternoon late arrival
adjust.excuseMissing: Do not count missing marks (nor the unmarked day)

employeeMonth.subtitle: Work day record: yellow cells are missing marks.
employeeMonth.clickHint: Click a day to correct or justify it.

import.subtitle: Upload the file exported by the time clock (.xls). Uploading a month again replaces its marks; HR adjustments are kept.
import.drop: Drop the time clock file here or click to choose it
import.formats: Time clock .xls or .xlsx, up to 10 MB
import.error: The file could not be imported.
import.newEmployeesTitle: New employees: {{count}}. Assign their group and decide if they appear in reports.
import.renamed: Name changed in the time clock
import.changedTitle: Manually corrected days that changed in the time clock: {{count}}
import.changedHint: The HR correction still applies. Review each day: if the time clock now has the right mark, remove the adjustment; otherwise keep it.

issuesPage.subtitle: Days the system could not resolve on its own. Click one to correct or justify it.

summary.subtitle: Attendance summary per employee, like the HR monthly sheet.
summary.name: Full name
summary.noteExits: * Missing check-outs: as if they left before the morning and afternoon end time.
summary.noteDays: ** Unmarked days: no marks all day, as if they did not come to work. Half day: the whole morning or afternoon.
summary.notePending: To review: days with inconsistencies nobody has reviewed yet. Justified items are not counted.

accumulated.subtitle: Accumulated late time over several months, from most to least late.
accumulated.invalidRange: Choose a start period before or equal to the end one (up to 24 months).

employees.subtitle: Created automatically on import (by the time clock AC-No). Assign the group and choose who appears in reports.
employees.inReportsLong: Appears in the record and the summaries

groups.subtitle: Groups used to split the reports. The order defines how they appear.

holidays.subtitle: No late arrivals or absences are counted that day. Add movable and decreed holidays here.

periods.subtitle: Control months (21st to 20th). Created on import; close them once the month is reviewed.
periods.reopenToEdit: Reopen it to change its dates.
periods.closeMessage: Close {{name}}? Nothing in those dates can be imported or adjusted until it is reopened.

settings.subtitle: Work schedule and calculation rules. A change shows up instantly in every screen and report.
settings.scheduleHint: Without a break it is a continuous day (like Friday): only check-in and check-out count.
settings.toleranceHint: After the tolerance, late time counts from the start time.
settings.duplicateWindowHint: Two marks closer than this are the same one.
settings.minBreakHint: A shorter break is flagged for review.
settings.middayFromHint: Before this time, the first mark is the check-in.
settings.afternoonExitFromHint: From this time on, the mark is the check-out.
settings.oddHint: Marks outside this range are flagged as unusual.

attendance.groupEmpty: There are no employees in this group. Assign it in Catalogs › Employees.
